description: Demonstrates the grouped/sibling ResultSets proposal from Discussion #45 (proposed, not yet finalized) in a second, unrelated domain from the RFC's original motivating case: a hyperparameter grid search rather than mutation testing. group.sequence here mirrors Optuna's real FrozenTrial.number semantics -- verified against optuna/optuna's actual source (optuna/trial/_frozen.py), which documents that field as 'unique and consecutive... for each Study' using 'zero-based numbering', independently confirming the same 0-indexed-position-known-upfront design already verified against AshwinUgale/muteval's select_mutants() for mutation testing. group.role uses 'candidate' rather than mutation testing's 'mutant', since role is an open string and each domain names its own group members -- this fixture exists specifically to prove the schema doesn't silently assume a mutation-testing-shaped role vocabulary.
